summary: Western Uranium & Vanadium Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the results of its Annual General and Special Meeting held June 26, 2026. Shareholders elected nominees to the board, ratifying MNP LLP as auditor, reapproved the 2023 Incentive Stock Option Plan, and reapproved the shareholder rights plan dated May 23, 2024, as described in the management proxy circular. Advisory votes were non-binding in nature. No required supermajority thresholds were disclosed. The filing is a routine meeting update, not a special situation. No event-driven catalyst or corporate action is present.
